IC1: - Histology: Part 1: Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) [AND] with histologic confirmation of adenocarcinoma. Adenocarcinoma with small-cell [OR] or neuroendocrine features is allowed. mCRPC is defined by prostate Cancer Working Group (PCWG )3 criteria. Part 2: mCRPC as defined above [OR] or pathologically confirmed metastatic renal cell carcinoma (RCC) as defined by world health organization (WHO)
IC3: - Measurable [OR] or evaluable disease: Part 1: Either measurable [OR] or evaluable disease for prostate cancer. Part 2: At least one measurable lesion as per RECIST v1.1.
IC4: - Evidence of disease progression on prior therapy that requires a new line of treatment
IC5: - Participants with accessible lesions enrolled in selected pharmacokinetic (PK)/pharmacodynamics (PD) cohorts and in Part 2 must agree to undergo the mandatory fresh tumor biopsies, unless collection of the biopsy presents a safety risk
